description: Identifier of a comic included in the final analysis.
notes: Primary key, and the join key used by every other table in this package. Read as text to retain leading zeros. The corresponding image file is image_id + '.jpg'; upstream annotations key on that filename. The original numbering is retained and is not consecutive. The image file itself is not included.

description: Identifier of a benchmark image excluded from the final analysis.
notes: Primary key. Disjoint from stimuli_images.csv; the two files partition the 348-image benchmark annotation snapshot. The corresponding image file is image_id + '.jpg'.

description: Author-supplied exclusion classification.
notes: Two-stage narrowing of the 348-image snapshot. Removed before the study ran: example (5 instructional examples) and non_compliant (13), leaving the 330-image pool shown to participants and models. Removed after: model_error (60), leaving the 270 analyzed. The 330 pool is the denominator for participant screening; the 270 for everything else. These are release-level classifications.

description: Explanation of the exclusion classification.
notes: Visual-format explanations are grouped and do not assign an image-specific subtype. Model-error subtypes are not recorded.

description: Identifier of the analyzed comic this transform rebuilds.
notes: Primary key; joins to stimuli_images.csv and to the response tables. The source and output files are image_id + '.jpg'.

description: Pixel width of the upstream source image before any processing.
notes: Recorded so that a reuser can confirm the download matches the version used in the study.

description: Pixel height of the upstream source image before any processing.
notes: Not applicable

description: Row index of the top of the comic band in the source image after it is scaled to width 1080.
notes: Measured on the width-normalized image, not on the raw download. Rows above this are the YES heading text and margin, which the preprocessing removed.

description: Height in pixels of the retained comic band.
notes: The band spans the full 1080-pixel width. Rows below src_band_top + src_band_height are the BUT heading text and margin.

description: Row index at which the band is pasted onto the 1080 x 1080 white study canvas.
notes: Usually (1080 - src_band_height) // 2; 21 of the 270 images retain their source position instead, so the recorded value is authoritative. Bounding-box coordinates are normalized against this canvas.

description: Image whose response received a reviewed manual translation correction.
notes: Composite primary key with subject_id; together they identify exactly one row of human_responses.csv.

description: Participant whose response was corrected.
values_or_format: P001 through P166; 9 distinct participants across the 11 corrections.
notes: Composite primary key with image_id. Two participants each received two corrections.

description: Original Korean response text, copied verbatim from the reason column of human_responses.csv.
values_or_format: Nonempty Korean text; 3-12 characters in most rows.
notes: Typos and fragments are preserved exactly; several rows are not well-formed Korean. Same column name and same value as in human_responses.csv.

description: English text gpt-4o-mini returned before correction.
notes: Often a refusal, a request for clarification, a transliteration, or a meaning inversion rather than a translation. Retained so the correction is auditable. This value does NOT appear in the distributed data.

description: Corrected English text, copied verbatim from the translated_reason column of human_responses.csv.
notes: Decided by reading other participants' responses to the same image. This is the value present in the distributed human_responses.csv.

description: Why the machine translation was wrong and what evidence supported the correction.
notes: Not applicable

description: Dataset-specific identifier for one evaluated model.
values_or_format: claude_opus_4.7; gemini_3.1_pro; gpt_5.5; gpt_5.6_sol; grok_4.3; mistral_large_3; mistral_small_4; qwen_3.7_plus
notes: Primary key; joins to model_responses.csv. This normalized label is distinct from the exact API model string.

description: Human-readable model family and version name.
values_or_format: Claude Opus 4.7; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview; GPT-5.5; GPT-5.6 Sol; Grok 4.3; Mistral Large 3; Mistral Small 4; Qwen3.7-Plus
notes: Not applicable

description: Provider of the API used in the experiment.
values_or_format: Anthropic; Google; OpenAI; xAI; Mistral AI; Alibaba Cloud
notes: Not applicable

description: Exact model identifier in the inspected experiment API configuration.
values_or_format: claude-opus-4-7; gemini-3.1-pro-preview; gpt-5.5; gpt-5.6-sol; grok-4.3; mistral-large-2512; mistral-small-2603; qwen3.7-plus
notes: Aliases or preview identifiers do not guarantee an immutable model snapshot. The API model string is not reformatted to match model_id.

description: Earliest stored timestamp among this model's 270 retained responses.
notes: No timezone offset is stored. This is not necessarily the start of the full experiment or the first API call.

description: Latest stored timestamp among this model's 270 retained responses.
notes: No timezone offset is stored. This is not necessarily the end of all API calls or retries.

description: Whether a timezone was recorded with the stored response timestamps.
notes: Do not infer UTC, Asia/Seoul, or another timezone from the offset-free timestamps.

description: Temperature explicitly passed by the current client code for this model, or a marker that the request omits it.
notes: not_explicitly_set does not mean temperature 0. A configured value is not necessarily sent by every provider client. Historical request payloads are unavailable.

description: Output-token limit passed by the inspected client code.
notes: The API parameter name is in max_output_tokens_parameter. This is a request limit, not observed response length or the model context-window size.

description: Name of the provider-specific request parameter that carries the output-token limit.
notes: Interpret the limit using this API parameter; accounting for reasoning tokens may vary by model and provider.

description: Whether a reasoning or thinking setting is explicitly supplied in the inspected request code.
notes: Does not establish that reasoning is disabled, or identify a provider default.

description: Whether top_p is explicitly supplied in the inspected request code.
notes: No numeric provider default has been inferred.

description: Whether a generation seed is explicitly supplied in the inspected request code.
notes: Not an analysis random seed. No numeric provider default has been inferred.

description: Number of responses retained for each model-image pair in this release.
notes: Does not establish the total number of API calls, validation attempts, retries, or reruns.

description: Number of distinct images represented for this model.
notes: Each model covers the same image set listed in stimuli_images.csv.

description: Number of distributed response rows for this model.
notes: Equals the number of corresponding rows in model_responses.csv, not the API-call count.

description: Provenance and verification limit of the reconstructed request settings.
notes: The entire cell is one provenance statement. Settings describe the inspected configuration/client code rather than retained historical request payloads.

description: Additional limitations on timestamps, retained-response counts, and reconstructed settings.
notes: Not applicable

description: Official provider page identifying the model or model family.
notes: Supports model identification; does not independently verify the study's historical API requests or settings.

description: Pseudonymous identifier linking responses from the same human participant.
notes: Composite primary key with image_id. Each participant was assigned 30 comics, but contributes 19-29 rows here: the analysis was restricted to 270 images afterwards and responses to images outside that set were removed with them. Unequal counts are this filtering, not rows lost during export. The private link to participant identifiers is not distributed.

description: Identifier of the comic to which the participant responded.
values_or_format: Five-digit, zero-padded string; one of the 270 retained image IDs.
notes: Read as text to retain leading zeros. Append .jpg to join to image_file in the image lists or upstream annotations.

description: Language of the original human explanation and study interface.
notes: Korean: 161 participants and 3922 rows. English: 5 participants and 119 rows.

data_type: JSON array of arrays of numbers
description: Stored visual-region annotations as a JSON array of boxes; each box is [nx1,ny1,nx2,ny2], giving its top-left and bottom-right corners relative to the full preprocessed study image.
values_or_format: [[nx1,ny1,nx2,ny2], ...]; 2-26 boxes per released human response. Intended coordinate range [0,1]; observed range approximately [-0.4298943094,1.4489469303].
notes: Origin is top-left; x increases rightward and y downward. The full reference image is 1080 x 1080 pixels, including margins. Box order is preserved and does not encode panel membership. Upstream downloads have different preprocessing; see README. Stored values are not clipped. 207 rows contain 214 boxes outside [0,1]. Analysis clips coordinates, sorts endpoints, and drops degenerate boxes; see README.

description: Original free-text explanation submitted by the participant.
values_or_format: Nonempty Unicode text in the language indicated by response_lang.
notes: Preserves original spelling, punctuation, and whitespace. Not replaced by the English translation.

description: Final English translation used in the translation-based analysis of a Korean response.
values_or_format: Nonempty English text when response_lang=ko; literal null when response_lang=en.
missing_values: null (literal string; not applicable to original English responses)
notes: Generated with gpt-4o-mini at temperature 0, followed by automated checks, selected retranslations, and manual corrections. This is derived text, not an independent response.

description: Letter of the title option selected for this image, not a correctness indicator.
notes: Match image_id + .jpg to upstream image_file; title_mcq supplies English options and title_mcq_answer supplies the reference letter. Korean participants saw translated options, which are not included in this release.

description: Respondent-selected Target-Norm Matrix category: personal (P) versus social/non-personal (S), crossed with value-based (V) versus logic-based/situational (L) incongruity.
notes: PV=personal/value-based; PL=personal/logic-based or situational; SV=social or non-personal/value-based; SL=social or non-personal/logic-based or situational. These are interpretations, not ground-truth labels.

description: Dataset identifier for the model that generated this response.
values_or_format: claude_opus_4.7; gemini_3.1_pro; gpt_5.5; gpt_5.6_sol; grok_4.3; mistral_large_3; mistral_small_4; qwen_3.7_plus
notes: Composite primary key with image_id. Foreign key to models.csv; consult api_model_id for the API spelling.

description: Identifier of the comic supplied to the model.
values_or_format: Five-digit, zero-padded string; one of the 270 retained image IDs.
notes: Read as text to retain leading zeros. Append .jpg to join to image_file in the image lists or upstream annotations.

data_type: JSON array of arrays of numbers
description: Stored visual-region annotations as a JSON array of boxes; each box is [nx1,ny1,nx2,ny2], giving its top-left and bottom-right corners relative to the full preprocessed study image.
values_or_format: [[nx1,ny1,nx2,ny2], ...]; 2-7 boxes per released model response; coordinates in [0,1].
notes: Origin is top-left; x increases rightward and y downward. The full reference image is 1080 x 1080 pixels, including margins. Box order is preserved and does not encode panel membership. Upstream downloads have different preprocessing; see README. These are retained, validated annotations, not the complete raw API payload.

description: Retained free-text explanation generated by the model.
notes: English for all models. The table intentionally has no response_lang or translated_reason column.

description: Letter of the title option selected for this image, not a correctness indicator.
notes: Match image_id + .jpg to the upstream title_mcq and title_mcq_answer fields. Models received the English options.

description: Respondent-selected Target-Norm Matrix category: personal (P) versus social/non-personal (S), crossed with value-based (V) versus logic-based/situational (L) incongruity.
notes: PV=personal/value-based; PL=personal/logic-based or situational; SV=social or non-personal/value-based; SL=social or non-personal/logic-based or situational. These are interpretations, not ground-truth labels.
